{{recipe}}

{{decameron}}

== Ingredients ==

* [[Cookbook:Vegetable|Vegetables]]
* [[Cookbook:Butter|Butter]]
* [[Cookbook:Stock|Stock]]
* 4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] uncooked [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]]
* 2–3 spoonfuls condiment for seasoning minestrone
* [[Cookbook:Grating|Grated]] [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]]

== Procedure ==

# [[Cookbook:Blanching|Blanch]] vegetables in [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiling]] salted water, then drain them and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] in butter.
# Add plenty of good stock, and put over low heat.
# Boil rice in stock until well-done. Add the stock and vegetables.
# Season with minestrone seasoning condiment, and serve with grated cheese handed separately.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* All sorts of vegetables will serve for this dish.
